results.willingness_to_pay_assessment: Multiple established SaaS vendors (Qoyod, Wafeq) already charge micro/small Saudi merchants recurring monthly fees (from SAR 60/mo at the lowest Qoyod tier up to SAR 600/mo) that bundle ZATCA Phase-2 e-invoicing compliance at no extra cost — direct proof the target segment already pays for this exact compliance function today. This validates that the underlying booking/no-show problem is monetized today, though the SAR-specific figure rests on a secondary blog rather than Fresha's own pricing page (which could not be fetched in this session), and no independent pricing was confirmed for the more directly comparable local WhatsApp-only competitors (OJlinker, Hajzak). Verdict: YES.
results.summary: Fresha's global pricing (from $14.95/month per team member) plus its 20% marketplace commission, combined with a secondary blog citing an SAR ~52/month KSA price point, show salon/clinic owners already pay for booking+reminder software; local WhatsApp-specific competitor pricing (OJlinker, Hajzak) could not be confirmed in this session.
